title: App on life-support which can be vibe-coded has no business to have subscription and those prices
body:
This is, while pleasant, is just quite minimal, basic and finished app on life-support with quite simple functionality. This is not a live service, not some advanced tool. It’s rarely updates while adding nothing new for years - and it has the subscription for that and “lifetime” access costs $60(or 99 internationally!), seriously? What are you ask us to pay for when this app is identical to how it was like 5+ years ago when I first used it? Stick to free version people.

UPD: also author’s salty response sees “hate” which doesn’t exists and TOTALLY misses the point. Also some remarks are just strange:

"if you do feel this app can be vibecoded in a weekend...” - bro this is colored habit tracker, extremely popular app category, maybe only todo lists will be easier to code with AI now

And this “AI… benefits from code people like me have shared...”: in author’s GitHub the most starred repo with a code was updated 10+ years ago, just fyi for those ppl reading it
author: DPolovinkin

title: Неплохо
body: Я только что скачал это приложение что можно отметить сразу то это приятный интерфейс. Так же хорошо что сходу мне рассказывают как пользоваться приложением что приятно.
author: Мальчик с Астаны
